entities.summary: Robert-Casimir Tonyui Messan Dosseh-Anyron was a Togolese Catholic archbishop. He was ordained a priest of Lomé on 21 December 1951. He became Archbishop of Lomé on 10 June 1962, a position which he served until his resignation on 13 February 1992.
